rawFindings.title: Incorrect range calculation for fix in report function
rawFindings.explanation: The range used for the fixer to replace the indentation text was changed from a start and end computed from node.location and indentation counts, to subtracting 1 and lastNodeCheckEndOffset incorrectly from node.range indices, which may cause incorrect ranges for fixes, potentially breaking auto-fixes or corrupting files.
rawFindings.suggestion: Correct the calculation of the textRange in the report function to ensure that the range matches the indentation characters exactly. Instead of subtracting an arbitrary 1 and lastNodeCheckEndOffset, calculate range based on node.range and the actual number of indentation characters obtained (gottenSpaces + gottenTabs).

rawFindings.title: Unused parameter 'lastNodeCheckEndOffset' misused in report function affecting range and range calculation
rawFindings.explanation: The new parameter 'lastNodeCheckEndOffset' is used in calculation of textRange for fixer but is sometimes incremented with unclear logic in 'checkLastReturnStatementLineIndent'. This can cause the fix range to be offset incorrectly leading to inaccurate fixes being applied to the code.
rawFindings.suggestion: Audit and revise the usage of lastNodeCheckEndOffset to ensure it correctly reflects the number of characters to skip at the end for the replaced range. Also, ensure consistent and clear management of that offset in all callers and usage sites to prevent incorrect auto-fix behavior.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect calculation of text range for fix in report function
rawFindings.explanation: The patch updates the textRange calculation to exclude the wrong characters at the end of the node range when reporting indentation errors using the fixer. This changes from a simple offset based on node.loc.end.column to a calculation that subtracts the actual number of indentation characters and an optional offset. However, the fix must ensure the range does not exclude needed characters or become incorrect for fixing. The modified formula subtracts gottenSpaces, gottenTabs, 1, and the lastNod
rawFindings.suggestion: Review and verify the updated range calculation logic in the report function to ensure it precisely covers the indentation characters to replace for fixing. Ensure that the start and end indices correspond exactly to the indentation characters and do not shift beyond bounds. If necessary, revert to the previous calculation or improve test coverage for fix application.
